g.text: A new cluster boots with Cilium rendered from the
chart embedded in the ichor binary and passed to
Once the Cilium DaemonSet is ready, the Job adopts
those objects as the Helm release cilium.
Talos re-applies bootstrap manifests on a Kubernetes
upgrade, so a stale entry would roll Cilium back.
